topic: v4: Doha Tamim, McCall MacBain, Deakin RTP, Radboud RSP/NL, KFUPM, Netherlands EUR22,000 (Twente UTS)

items.claim: Tamim: 100% tuition + housing + monthly stipend + health insurance for international master's
items.official: For international students: Full tuition waiver (100%). Student housing. Monthly stipend. Health insurance.
items.note: Stipend amount not published on the page. Apply for admission first; admitted students are then contacted and invited to apply for the scholarship.

items.claim: Admission deadline 15 Jan 2027 (opens 1 Sep 2026)
items.official: 01 Sep 2026 Admission Application Open for 2027-2028; 15 Jan 2027 Admission Application Deadline for 2027-2028
items.note: Homepage also says 'Application Deadline 15 January 2027'.

items.claim: Scholarship conditions require >=10 h/week work for the Institute (master's Tamim)
items.official: The 10 h/week clause ('must commit... working for the Institute... not less than ten hours per week during the semester; partial grantees up to 15 h') appears only under the Doctoral Studies scholarship tab. The Master's Tamim Scholarship terms list no work obligation: no combining with other scholarships; continuation depends on academic standing; excludes Executive Master's/diplomas/certificates; prior Institute master's scholarship holders ineligible.
items.note: Do not tell applicants the Tamim master's carries a 10 h/week work duty; that is the doctoral rule.

items.claim: Programmes: social sciences/humanities/public policy (Public Admin, Development Economics, Conflict Mgmt & Humanitarian Action); no health programme
items.official: SEAPP offers Master in Public Administration (MPA), Public Policy (MPP), Development Economics (MDE) plus executive masters (not covered by Tamim). Homepage: '17 Master's Programs'. School of Social Sciences and Humanities also offers programmes.
items.note: Admissions programme list page did not render; Conflict Management & Humanitarian Action not confirmed here. No clinical/public-health master's seen. Tamim excludes Executive Masters.

items.claim: Tuition and fees + CAD 2,300/month in academic terms + relocation grant
items.official: Tuition and fees for the full normal duration of the master's or professional program; A living stipend of $2,300 per month during academic terms; A one-time relocation grant for moving to Montreal. Also up to $5,000 for summer initiatives.
items.note: Master's or second-entry professional (BCL/JD, DMD, MDCM); PhDs, executive masters, certificates, part-time excluded. Includes MDCM medicine and MSc/MScA but check McGill programme list.

items.claim: International deadline 19 Aug 2026 (2027 cohort)
items.official: International: August 19, 2026, 4:00 PM Eastern Time. Canada/US: September 23, 2026. 'Applications for Summer/Fall 2027 are closed.'
items.note: Closed. Next cycle (Summer/Fall 2028) dates not yet published; FAQ says deadline is 12-15 months before programme start.

items.claim: Up to 30 full scholarships (10 international) plus finalist CAD 20,000 and regional CAD 10,000 awards
items.official: International: 10 McCall MacBain Scholarships; 25 Finalist Awards of $20,000 per year for up to 2 years (tenable at McGill); 15 Regional Awards of $10,000 (any public university in Canada). 20 scholarships for Canadians.
items.note: Finalist award is $20,000 per year for up to 2 years (not one-off).

items.claim: Who is eligible / Bangladesh eligible
items.official: International applicants = 'Any other citizenship or nationality' (than Canadian). 2027 cohort criteria: current student on track for first bachelor's by Aug 2027; OR first bachelor's in last five years (Jan 2021 or later); OR first bachelor's >5 years ago and aged 30 or under on 1 Jan 2026. Must meet McGill's minimum degree and language requirements.
items.note: Bangladesh is not named; eligible as an 'any other nationality' international applicant (inference). Bangladesh has no outreach-partner university in the published list (Pakistan and India do); partner nomination is not stated as required. Applicant needs a recent first bachelor's (within 5 years) or age <=30.

items.claim: Stipend AUD 37,450 p.a. (tax exempt), relocation AUD 500-1,500, OSHC for international
items.official: a stipend of $37,450 per annum tax exempt; a relocation allowance from $500 to $1,500 (for single to family)...; For international candidates only: single Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) policy for the duration of the student visa.
items.note: Page does not state the stipend as '2027 rate' explicitly; terms PDFs linked are 2026.

items.claim: Tuition fees offset
items.official: Doctoral degree: three years for stipend and four years for the tuition fees offset. Research masters: two years stipend and two years fees offset.
items.note: Eligibility: >=4 years tertiary study and 80% or equivalent in research component; on-campus full-time; only top-ranked applicants offered an RTP.

items.claim: International round for Feb 2027 closed 25 Oct 2026
items.official: 2027 international round: opens 6 July 2026, closes 23 August 2026 (February 2027 intake). 2027 domestic round: opens 6 July 2026, closes 25 October 2026. Outcome by 6 Nov 2026 (international), 23 Dec 2026 (domestic).
items.note: 25 Oct is the DOMESTIC round; international closed 23 Aug 2026. Either way it is closed. Deadlines do not apply to Institute for Frontier Materials, IISRI or A2I2 applicants who can apply at any time (per how-to-apply page snippet). Next round dates not yet published.

items.claim: RSP reduces tuition to EUR 2,771 for 2027/28; covers visa, residence permit, insurance; living costs excluded
items.official: A Radboud Scholarship will reduce your tuition fee to EUR 2,771 (amount to be confirmed)... covers costs for visa, residence permit, health insurance and liability insurance... The costs of living and studying in the Netherlands are not covered.
items.note: 'Amount to be confirmed'. Partial scholarship, nominal programme duration; max 22 awards for 2027/28; two-year programmes need all first-year courses passed.

items.claim: NL Scholarship EUR 5,000, stackable
items.official: The scholarship amounts to EUR 5,000. The grant is awarded for 1 year... You can be awarded both the NLS and RSP, or just the RSP. You cannot be awarded just the NLS.
items.note: Max 22 NLS for 2027-28. That page's conditions list still carries stale 2026/1 Sep 2026 wording in items 5-6.

items.claim: Submit by 31 Jan 2027; complete by 14 Feb 2027
items.official: submitted your application in the online OSIRIS Application system on 31 January 2027 23:59 CET at the latest... complete by 14 February 2027 23:59 CET at the latest. Decision before mid-April 2027.
items.note: Documents: two reference letters + CV via OSIRIS; Erasmus Mundus and joint-degree masters excluded.

items.claim: Bangladesh (non-EU/EEA) eligible
items.official: Eligible countries or regions: All non-EU/non-EEA countries
items.note: Bangladesh not named but falls under all non-EU/EEA. Must hold bachelor's from outside NL and be fully admitted.

items.claim: Full scholarship: stipend, free furnished housing, medical, airfare (intl), no tuition, textbooks
items.official: Full-time MS or PhD students with a full scholarship: Stipend according to category; free-furnished on-campus housing; Air tickets only for International students; Medical/dental care; Subsidized meals; Free study, No tuition fee; Free textbooks.
items.note: Scholarship is for 'distinguished applicants with high GPA'; direct PhD (5 yrs) funded for first 4 years. Not automatic for all admits.

items.claim: Stipend ~SAR 1,725/month MS, ~SAR 2,400 PhD, SAR 950 first month
items.official: Official scholarship page says only 'Stipend according to category'; no SAR amounts. The KFUPM student handbook says 'university scholarship... to all regular graduate studies students in the amount of SAR 890' (unclear period).
items.note: Do not quote SAR 1,725/2,400 as official. Handbook (ses.kfupm.edu.sa/static/documents/student_handbook.pdf) figure of SAR 890 is a different number.

items.claim: Next deadline
items.official: cgis.kfupm.edu.sa banner shows 'MS Programs (Project-Based) 10 February 2027'. No dated deadline for MS (Thesis-Based)/PhD on cgis or apply.kfupm.edu.sa; the thesis/PhD 'Start Applications' link (nabegh.kfupm.edu.sa/cycle/32/apply) is live.
items.note: Project-based MS is NOT scholarship-funded (fee-paying). Thesis/PhD date must be checked in the nabegh portal. Graduate bulletin: applications open twice a year.

items.claim: STEM/engineering only; field mismatch for MBBS
items.official: Thesis MS requires 'four-year Bachelor's in engineering or science... with a major in the proposed field or evidence of suitable background'; GPA 3.00+ for scholarship applicants (2.50 non-scholarship); IELTS 6.0 (PhD 6.5); two recommendation letters. Business MS also exists.
items.note: Programmes are engineering/science/business; no medicine. Open to international applicants (visa required).

items.claim: Unnamed 'up to EUR 22,000, deadline 1 April 2027' Netherlands award
items.official: University of Twente Scholarship (UTS): 'EUR 3,000 - EUR 22,000 for one year'; 'Application deadline 1 April 2027'; form opens 15 Oct 2026 09.00 CET, closes 1 April 2027, 16.00 CET (September 2027 programmes). Results first week of May 2027.
items.note: Official page matches both amount and date, so identification is supported (the notes' 'Twente deadlines 1 Feb/1 May' were wrong). Caveats: partial, not full, 'no costs paid on your behalf'; second-year equal amount if avg 7/10 and 50% ECTS; non-EU/EEA; must be admitted first; top 5-10% of class; IELTS 6.5 (speaking 6.0); Bangladesh is in the eligible-countries list; not for ITC or pre-master. Poster's 'possible second-year' and 'outstanding non-EU' consistent.

summary: Deakin: 25 Oct 2026 was the domestic round; international closed 23 Aug 2026 (both closed). Doha: 10 h/week work rule is doctoral only, not master's Tamim. KFUPM: SAR stipend figures and thesis/PhD deadline not official. Item 19 identified as Twente UTS (EUR 3,000-22,000, 1 Apr 2027 16:00 CET), notes' Twente dates were wrong. McCall MacBain and Radboud figures confirmed; McCall needs a recent first bachelor's or age <=30.
